name: Colma Creek
intro: Creek level and rain at Orange Memorial Park in South San Francisco, and the Bay tide at Alameda. Thresholds are for the community downstream of Orange Memorial Park.
note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).

name: San Bruno Creek
intro: Creek level at First Avenue in South San Francisco / San Bruno, rain in the upper and lower watershed, and the Bay tide at Alameda. The creek at First Avenue rises and falls with the tide.

name: Belmont Creek
intro: Creek level at Old County Road, rain at Old County Road, and the Bay tide at Redwood City. Thresholds are for the Harbor Industrial Area community downstream of the Caltrain crossing. Flooding is likely if 30-minute rain exceeds 0.20 inches, or if 4-hour rain exceeds 0.42 inches and the tide is high.
note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).

name: Atherton Channel
intro: Channel levels at Alameda de las Pulgas and just upstream of the Caltrain crossing, rain at Caltrain, and the Bay tide at Redwood City. Thresholds are for the community downstream of the Caltrain crossing.
note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).

name: San Francisquito Creek
intro: Creek level at Stanford (USGS), rain in the hills above at Wunderlich, Windy Hill and Trappers Trail, and the Bay tide at Redwood City.
note: Flood levels at Stanford are OneRain's (Oct 2026): Flood Monitoring = potential flooding; Flood Watch = flooding likely; Flood Warning = projected flooding in downstream reaches. Not yet reviewed by staff. Tide station to confirm.

name: San Mateo Creek
intro: Creek level below Crystal Springs Reservoir (USGS), rain at Crystal Springs Cottage nearby, and the Bay tide at Alameda. Crystal Springs Reservoir holds back much of the water from the upper watershed.
note: Flood levels below Crystal Springs are OneRain's (Oct 2026), which OneRain sets on flow: Flood Watch = 200 cfs (about 6.70 ft), flooding probable with continued rain; Flood Warning = 250 cfs (about 7.00 ft), active flooding likely downstream. Not yet reviewed by staff. Tide station to confirm.

name: Green Hills Creek
intro: Creek level at Green Hills Country Club in Millbrae, rain at Pilarcitos Dam nearby, and the Bay tide at Alameda. The creek drains to Highline Canal.
note: No flood levels have been set for this creek yet. Its status uses rain in the hills above and how fast the creek is rising. Tide station to confirm.

name: Pilarcitos Creek
intro: Creek levels on Pilarcitos Creek from below Pilarcitos Lake to Half Moon Bay (USGS), and rain at Pilarcitos Dam.
note: Flood levels at Half Moon Bay are OneRain's (Oct 2026): Flood Monitoring = potential flooding; Flood Watch = flooding probable with continued rain; Flood Warning = flooding likely in downstream reaches; Major Flood Stage = damaging flooding. Not yet reviewed by staff. The other Pilarcitos gauges have none.

name: San Gregorio Creek
intro: Creek level at San Gregorio (USGS) and rain at La Honda.
note: Flood levels at San Gregorio are OneRain's (Oct 2026): Flood Monitoring = potential flooding; Flood Watch = flooding probable with continued rain; Flood Warning = flooding likely in downstream reaches; Major Flood Stage = damaging flooding. Not yet reviewed by staff.

name: Pescadero Creek
intro: Creek levels at Stage Road and near Pescadero (USGS), and rain at La Honda nearby.
note: Flood levels near Pescadero (USGS gauge) are OneRain's (Oct 2026): Flood Watch = flooding likely; Flood Warning = projected flooding in downstream reaches. OneRain sets no Flood Monitoring level here, and none at Stage Road. Not yet reviewed by staff.

name: Butano Creek
intro: Creek levels near Cloverdale Road (OneRain backup sensor) and at the USGS gauge beside it, and rain at Cloverdale Road.
note: Flood levels near Cloverdale Road are OneRain's (Oct 2026), set on its backup sensor: Flood Watch = flooding likely; Flood Warning = flooding likely in downstream reaches. OneRain sets no Flood Monitoring level here. The only rain gauge is low in the watershed. Not yet reviewed by staff.
